summary: Swing draws inside a JPanel's paintComponent method, using a Graphics object to fill and outline shapes. Swing calls paintComponent for you whenever the window needs drawing.
notes: Java's (0, 0) is the top-left corner and y increases going down, unlike turtle's centered origin.
Each fill or draw call uses the color from the most recent g.setColor(...).
SwingUtilities.invokeLater(...) creates the window on the event dispatch thread, where Swing code must run.
pitfall: Leaving out super.paintComponent(g) skips clearing the panel, so the background color never appears and old drawings can stay on screen.
